en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large hilltop castle overlooking a small town. The multi‑storey castle has steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, corner towers and a central onion‑domed turret with a finial. Below the castle, older stone walls and vegetation cover the slope. In the foreground stand two gabled townhouses with German‑style architecture and painted signs on their facades; horse‑drawn carts are parked in the street. A path with a metal railing and dense bushes leads toward the houses.
